question: Do frozen E141 family-fold value networks rank measured Act2 first-card alternatives better, after early-card gates failed?
scope: Keep the original first-boss relic choice. Evaluate only its measured Act2 first-card options under fixed-parent continuation. Retain all earlier deaths and missing scoped opportunities unchanged.
folds: Exact original E73 3-fold rule. Use only checkpoint excluding the evaluated entire seed family.
gate: Fit-only evidence probe: for each arm require net gain>=30/1536 and descriptive paired p<.025 versus parent before implementing a later-scoped deployment candidate. No auto adoption or model selection on external labels.
limits: New development use of the same historical fit families, not an independent acceptance test. Current ValuePolicy is first-card scoped; this probe computes scores on stored real public states and raw terminal labels. If gates fail, no new scoped implementation or full-game candidate evaluation follows from this probe.
